description: This file defines the TargetRegistry class and related classes for managing browser targets, pages, and contexts in a Firefox environment, including download interception, page creation, and browser context management.

classes.name: DownloadInterceptor
classes.description: Handles download request interception and completion events, manages download handlers and emits corresponding events.

classes.name: TargetRegistry
classes.description: Manages browser targets, pages, and contexts, including creation, disposal, and event handling.

classes.name: PageTarget
classes.description: Represents a page target, managing page-specific actions like navigation, viewport, dialogs, and recording.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context, managing permissions, cookies, proxies, and page settings.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a modal dialog, providing methods to accept, dismiss, and retrieve dialog information.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TargetRegistry.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TargetRegistry, sets up observers, event listeners, and download interception.

methods.name: shouldBustHTTPAuthCacheForProxy
methods.description: Determines if the HTTP auth cache should be cleared for a given proxy.

methods.name: _updateProxiesWithSameAuthCacheAndDifferentCredentials
methods.description: Updates the set of proxies with conflicting authentication credentials.

methods.name: cancelDownload
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by UUID.

methods.name: getProxyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves proxy information for a given channel.

methods.name: browserContextForId
methods.description: Retrieves a browser context by its ID.

methods.name: browserContextForUserContextId
methods.description: Retrieves a browser context by its user context ID.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page in a specified browser context.

methods.name: _newPageInternal
methods.description: Internal method to create a new page and open a window.

methods.name: targetForBrowser
methods.description: Retrieves target associated with a specific browser.

methods.name: targetForBrowserId
methods.description: Retrieves target associated with a specific browser ID.
